description: This file defines the StatisticalValidations class with static methods for validating numerical and boolean values used in statistical calculations within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: StatisticalValidations
classes.description: Provides static methods to validate if input values are proper floats, integers, or booleans for statistical calculations.

methods.name: validateFloat
methods.description: Validates that the input is numeric and returns it as a float, otherwise throws an exception.

methods.name: validateInt
methods.description: Validates that the input is numeric, converts it to a float, floors it, and returns as int; throws exception if not numeric.

methods.name: validateBool
methods.description: Validates that the input is a boolean or numeric, and returns it as a boolean; throws exception if invalid.
